note: ADR 1022: a construct-only local class (one `new`, after it in the same component body, no `this`/`super`/`extends`) runs its constructor, field initializers and the method called on that `new` in the body: STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED (MethodRead), REACTIVE_WRITE_IN_OWNED_SCOPE (CtorWrite, ConstBound) and ACTION_CALLED_IN_OWNED_SCOPE (FieldAction) are covered by violations (they were uncertifiable, `function-run-unplaced`); InHandler's write in a click handler is silent and clean; the members nothing places (two constructions, `this`, a run in a handler, a computed member) fire and stay covered by uncertifiable rows; NeverCalled and Shadowed never run the write
